weekAgenda.label: Mon 25 · Arrival & welcome
weekAgenda.description: Proposed midday arrival in St. Thomas and check-in, followed by a sunset welcome with the FOGV, Blue Tarp, CFEG and TATEL teams.

weekAgenda.label: Tue 26 · Keynote & forum
weekAgenda.description: Proposed Entertainment Infrastructure keynote, The Islands as a Studio, followed by Our Islands Are on Screen. Are Our Stories? Each session has one proposed lead; participation and venues remain unconfirmed.

weekAgenda.label: Wed 27 · Premiere panel & working session
weekAgenda.description: Premiering the Work: Ginger Thomas & Wuk Up Competition, followed by an optional afternoon working session on the schedule and dojo build, if time permits.

weekAgenda.label: Thu 28 · Keeping It Local & screening
weekAgenda.description: The Keeping It Local panel, followed by an evening red-carpet screening of the December premieres and island films, with Kevin Moolenaar proposed to host the Q&A. Screening time remains TBC.

weekAgenda.label: Fri 29 · Immersion & closing
weekAgenda.description: From Screen to Immersion with a live student-built Haaard Wuk Dojo VR demo, TATEL closing and a co-production roundtable.

weekAgenda.label: Sat 30 · Optional Culture Tales shoot
weekAgenda.description: Optional on-location Culture Tales shoot with students: a community interview and location capture. Afternoon at leisure. Participation, time and location are to be confirmed.

weekAgenda.label: Sun 31 · Departure & follow-up
weekAgenda.description: Departure day. Session recordings and next steps follow; individual travel arrangements are separate from the summit schedule.

sessions.title: One Island, Too Many Systems
sessions.description: Connect a small set of place assets through common identifiers and a map, without assuming all island systems can be replaced.
sessions.outcome: Map three disconnected services, their users, and one costly handoff.
sessions.specialists: Local GIS/data custodian; integration engineer

sessions.title: The Answer Is Somewhere in the Records
sessions.description: Help people find reliable public-service information with citations and human escalation.
sessions.outcome: Identify a public-service question people cannot answer reliably and map the source material.
sessions.specialists: Agency records owner; local service users; AI engineer

sessions.title: One Visitor, Five Disconnected Bookings
sessions.description: Treat the full arrival experience as one journey, while operators retain responsibility for their services.
sessions.outcome: Map an airport-to-ferry-to-stay journey and locate missed handoffs and avoidable waiting.
sessions.specialists: Airline/airport and ferry operations leads; itinerary engineer

sessions.title: Everyone Knows the Island; Whose Story Is It?
sessions.description: Who chooses which island stories are told? Create a small community-approved story collection whose contributors retain a say in its use.
sessions.outcome: Identify an overlooked story and the people whose knowledge and permission are essential.
sessions.specialists: Local culture bearer; oral-history custodian; recording crew

sessions.title: Who Owns Place Data?
sessions.description: Create a discussion draft allocating data responsibilities, permissible uses, and review points for a pilot.
sessions.outcome: Map a sample build's data contributors, custodians, users, and unresolved authority questions.
sessions.specialists: USVI/BVI-qualified privacy or public-records counsel; local data owner

sessions.title: When the Island Goes Offline

modes.name: Ferries & resort launches
modes.summary: All five islands across four days
modes.description: A regional alternative with scheduled services, taxis, and resort launches. It switches between featured series and misses some stages. Published departures are references, not January 2027 reservations.
modes.warning: Five islands every day does not fit the reviewed schedules. Lovango and Scrub services require reservations and eligible guest access or a conference agreement. Independent connections are not guaranteed.

days.start: Start near Red Hook, St. Thomas.

items.title: Red Hook → Lovango
items.detail: Published resort departure; 15–30-minute crossing. Only 15 minutes after Tech for walking and boarding: the operator must approve this connection, or omit the 9am session. Resort access must be reserved.

items.title: Lovango → Cruz Bay
items.detail: Published resort departure and approximately 10-minute crossing. Have lunch on Lovango first; allow arrival/venue access on St. John. This misses the 1pm circuit feature; attend the 5pm second feature instead.

items.title: Cruz Bay → Lovango
items.detail: Published resort departure and approximately 10-minute crossing. Reserve/check in before departure. Only about 15 minutes from arrival to the 11am session: a nearby venue is essential.

items.title: Lovango → Red Hook
items.detail: Published resort departure. Allow 15–30 minutes underway, boarding/check-in before departure, and venue access on arrival. Lunch before departure; free time before Tech.

days.start: Check in at Red Hook by 7:30am; confirm the carrier’s requirements.

items.title: Red Hook → West End, Tortola · international
items.detail: Tourism-board-listed departure, not a January booking. Estimate 45–60 minutes underway plus 30–90+ minutes clearance/arrival. Target the later 1pm connection rather than relying on the 10am boat.

items.title: West End → Great Harbour, Jost
items.detail: Published New Horizon departure; crossing estimated 20–30 minutes. Allow 30-minute check-in and nearby venue access.

items.title: Jost → West End → Trellis Bay → Scrub
items.detail: Published 5pm ferry; estimate 20–30 minutes underway, 10–15 to meet the driver, 45–75 by prebooked taxi, and 15 for launch check-in. Target the 6:45pm resort launch (10-minute crossing); 7:45pm may be needed. Reserve resort access and confirm connections.

days.overnight: Jost Van Dyke; next-day departure separately arranged.

items.title: Scrub → Trellis Bay → West End → Jost
items.detail: Published launch: approximately 10 minutes. Allow disembarkation, 45–75 minutes by taxi across Tortola, and 30-minute ferry check-in. Target the published 1pm West End ferry, estimated Jost arrival 1:20–1:30pm. A listed 4pm ferry may be a fallback for a nearby 5pm venue, subject to availability.

modes.name: Sailing yacht / catamaran
modes.summary: All five islands across four days
modes.description: A cruising alternative with overnight accommodation aboard at authorized locations. Estimates assume approximately six knots underway. A fast motor yacht belongs in the powerboat comparison. This agenda skips some stages of the featured series.
modes.warning: Sailing cannot fit five daily islands into the proposed two-hour start intervals. Berths, tender landings, weather, and captain-approved passages must be arranged. A separate fast launch would use the powerboat scenario’s limits.
